design_philosophy: Dark neon / cyberpunk aesthetic mimicking high-end DJ hardware (Pioneer CDJ / Traktor). The player is the hero. Use deep void blacks, sharp angular UI elements, glowing neon accents, and technical typography. Avoid AI-slop purple gradients. Optimize for low-light club environments with fluid animations.

layout.strategy: Control Room Grid for the Player, Bento Grid for the Mix Library.
layout.spacing: Generous spacing (p-6 to p-12) for library. Dense, functional spacing (p-2 to p-4) for the player controls.
layout.borders: Hardware-inspired. 1px solid borders. No soft shadows. Use drop-shadow for neon glows.
layout.radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to mimic physical hardware screens.

surfaces.player_container: Retro-Futurism / Terminal Look. Deep black background, 1px laser cyan border, subtle cyan drop-shadow on active state.
surfaces.mix_card: Grid Borders strategy. border-collapse style layout. 1px subtle borders on right and bottom. Hover state triggers a neon border glow and slight lift.
surfaces.persistent_mini_player: Glassmorphism with a twist: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/80, with a 1px border-t border-[#00F0FF]/30.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors rounded-none shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-none

inputs.style: bg-surface border border-border text-white focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-none font-mono

waveform.style: Canvas or SVG based. Acid green (#39FF14) for played portion, dark grey (#1A1D2E) for unplayed. Add a subtle neon glow effect (drop-shadow).

vu_meter.style: Segmented vertical or horizontal bars. Green -> Yellow -> Red (#39FF14 -> #F2E900 -> #FF003C) to mimic Pioneer mixers.

components.tags: bg-surface border border-border text-xs px-2 py-1 uppercase tracking-wider text-primary

animations.player_state: Pulsing glow on the play button when paused. Solid intense glow when playing.
animations.waveform_sync: Smooth linear translation of the waveform based on playback position.

mix_library.description: Grid of mix cards with cover art, BPM, genre, duration, play count.
mix_library.card_style: Image wrapper with aspect-square. Hover reveals play button overlay (bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm). Text info below image.

now_playing.description: Full-screen player with large animated waveform, VU meters, big cover art, and cue sheet list.
now_playing.layout: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4). Left column (col-span-4): Cover Art & Metadata. Center/Right (col-span-8): Waveform, Transport Controls, VU meters, and scrollable Cue Sheet tracklist below.
now_playing.special_elements: Current track in cue sheet has glowing text and a left-border accent. Clicking a track updates playback time.

persistent_player.layout: Fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 h-20. Flex container. Left: Mini cover + title. Center: Transport controls + mini waveform/progress bar. Right: Volume control.

admin_upload.description: Admin upload panel (drag-drop mp3/flac + .cue file, cover art, metadata).
admin_upload.layout: Centered narrow container (max-w-2xl). Dash-border dropzone for files. Standard neon-styled Shadcn form inputs.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. Examples: data-testid='play-pause-button', data-testid='mix-card', data-testid='cue-track-item'.
